statusLegend.inherited_unverified: Code exists in pinned upstream; integration and live behavior have not been verified here.
statusLegend.planned: Approved requirement requiring implementation or equivalence verification.
statusLegend.inactive_upstream: Source exists but is not registered.
statusLegend.implemented_local: Implemented and exercised locally; hosted deployment and live provider verification are separate release gates.
statusLegend.partial: A working subset is implemented; the implementation note identifies remaining coverage.

discrepancies: Postiz public overview says 34 platforms; pinned manager registers 35 identifiers. Adapter identifiers differ from distinct network counts.

features.name: Vercel frontend and Docker backend/orchestrator
features.notes: Approved customization; not established by the source baseline.
features.implementationNote: Independent Next.js/Vercel configuration, source-based Docker image and supporting Compose prepared. Cloud deployment and host capacity validation pending.

features.name: Supabase invitations, sessions and password recovery
features.notes: Approved customization; not established by the source baseline.
features.implementationNote: Invitation-only email identities, confirmed server-verified sessions, recovery callback, owner bootstrap and role-independent identity mapping. Hosted SMTP/domain validation pending.

features.name: Private application schema and Prisma migrations
features.notes: Approved customization; not established by the source baseline.
features.implementationNote: Prisma multi-schema models and six migrations in the unexposed postiz schema; application restore drill passed locally.

features.name: Private media, resumable uploads and signed delivery
features.notes: Approved customization; not established by the source baseline.
features.implementationNote: Private signed TUS uploads, MIME/size validation, immutable sealed objects, tenant-authorized signed downloads and processing/clipping adapters. Paid processing not activated.

features.name: Agency administration and brand organizations
features.notes: Approved customization; not established by the source baseline.
features.implementationNote: Agency groups, assigned brand organizations, admin brand creation and Toronto timezone policy.

features.name: Staff membership and client-reviewer permissions
features.notes: Approved customization; not established by the source baseline.
features.implementationNote: Staff roles, client-only reviews/reports, invitations and revocation; HTTP tenant isolation tested.

features.name: Versioned approval gates at scheduling and delivery
features.notes: Approved customization; not established by the source baseline.
features.implementationNote: Versioned content/media/settings/destination/time snapshots and backend/Temporal publish gates; serialized edits, invalidation and uncertain-delivery reconciliation.

features.name: Separate implementation, credentials, approval and live status
features.notes: Approved customization; not established by the source baseline.
features.implementationNote: Connection readiness, provider inventory and separate credentials/approval/live status; no network has live verification.

features.name: Draft, immediate, scheduled and repeating posts
features.implementationNote: Inherited scheduling with V113 approval/ledger gates, local DST and recovery tests. Live delivery and full Temporal end-to-end faults pending.

features.name: Publishing and channel-management API
features.implementationNote: REST preserved with brand isolation and approval enforcement. API scheduling rejection checked locally; full contract suite pending.

features.name: CLI/MCP and AI-agent integration surfaces
features.implementationNote: Inherited CLI/MCP retained, absolute backend OAuth URLs and current-membership checks adapted; external client smoke tests pending.

features.name: Bulk scheduling and CSV imports
features.notes: Inherited equivalence requires verification.
features.implementationNote: Quoted CSV preview, ordered brand-owned media, draft-only commit, deterministic row IDs and leased restart recovery.

features.name: Automated reusable content queues

features.implementationNote: Recurring posts and CSV repeat intervals are available; ordered evergreen category queues remain to implement.

features.name: Saved posts and reusable templates

features.implementationNote: Inherited sets/signatures are available; a dedicated searchable reusable-post template library remains to implement.

features.name: Existing provider-native account and post analytics
features.notes: Method declarations identify source evidence only; metrics are not live-verified.

features.name: Historical metric storage and period comparisons

features.name: Audience and format performance analysis
features.implementationNote: Inherited provider-native series are retained; demographic and format analysis needs additional approved adapters and UI.

features.name: Hashtag discovery and performance analysis

features.name: Competitor tracking and benchmarking
features.implementationNote: Watchlists plus Bluesky/YouTube public collectors; additional permitted network collectors and broad benchmarking remain.

features.name: Best publishing times from available history

features.name: Organic and paid campaign dashboards
features.implementationNote: Organic/post summaries and separate ad-account campaign data exist; unified campaign tagging and attribution remain.

features.name: Website/blog tracking and real-time traffic
features.implementationNote: First-party beacon, registered-origin checks, daily anonymous visitor hashes, page/referrer totals and a recent visitor view. Production traffic verification pending.

features.name: Branded PDF/PowerPoint reports and CSV exports
features.implementationNote: Branded PDF/PowerPoint and formula-safe CSV export, private brand-owned logo and multi-page export QA.

features.name: Scheduled reports and email delivery

features.name: Reusable brand report templates

features.name: AI-assisted reporting and analysis

features.name: Shareable reports and live dashboard links

features.name: Link click and click-through analytics
features.implementationNote: Per-link tracked redirects and click totals; impression-based click-through rates and bot filtering remain.
